tokens/motion/slider.ts

Description

Knob-spring tunables for the slider widgets (theme slider, switch slider). Sole declaration site (zero-hardcoding rule): the WebGL render loops, the 2D fallbacks, and the wasm state pushes all chase targetP through the same damped spring — v += (−(p−target)·K − v·C)·dt; p += v·dt — replacing the old frame-rate-coupled geometric lerp.

Two regimes share the integrator: SNAP — release/tap/programmatic moves: ωn=√170≈13.0 rad/s, ζ≈0.72 → ~4% overshoot, settle ≈0.4s — the little elastic arrival that reads organic instead of dead. DRAG — finger-follow: ζ=1.0 (critically damped, ωn≈20.5) — the knob tracks the pointer with a ~50ms fluid lag, never oscillates, and inherits velocity into the release snap so a flick whips into the stop.
